analysis.summary: Zenoti and Boulevard both push comparison pages and customer stories at buyers. Mangomint publishes the most help content, led by an AI receptionist launch, while Phorest repeats pages at scale.

points.text: Zenoti published 21 customer stories and a comparison page against Boulevard, so it is going after Boulevard's switchers directly.
Mangomint launched Mira, its AI receptionist, with about 6 pages, and added 29 new pages overall, mostly free guides and templates for owners.
Phorest has 35 new pages, but many share one title, so they look like variants of a few themes: clinics, multi-location and payment costs.

Boulevard.play: Comparison pages, franchise-scale case studies and franchise guides, with 7 new pages and 8 updates.

Zenoti.play: Mass of customer stories plus six 2026 comparison pages, including one against Boulevard.

Mindbody.play: No new or updated pages; the site is mostly templated /business/ and /company/ pages.

Vagaro.play: No new or updated pages; the site is only 193 templated /pro/ pages.

Mangomint.play: Launches Mira AI receptionist, and publishes many how-tos, idea lists and free templates.
Mangomint.aimed: Owners of salons, spas, barbershops, tattoo shops

Phorest.play: Repeated pages on medspa and clinic software, multi-location, marketplace costs and payment fees.

Fresha.play: Only 4 pages on the site and no activity.

shared.title: Head-to-head comparison pages
shared.text: Boulevard has 4, Zenoti 6 and Phorest 19 comparison-type pages. Zenoti's include Boulevard. Expect rivals to meet switchers at the comparing stage.

shared.title: Medspa focus
shared.text: Boulevard, Zenoti, Phorest and Mangomint all publish medspa pages, from EMR (medical records) and charting to booking stats. Medspa is a contested segment.

shared.title: AI front desk messaging
shared.text: Zenoti's stories mention an AI receptionist, SmartBot and AI Scribe. Phorest pitches AI features, and Mangomint built a launch around Mira. AI is now a key selling point.

gaps.title: Switching and migration guides
gaps.text: Mangomint has phone number transfer help, but nobody publishes a multi-location switching playbook covering data, staff training and cutover. Boulevard could own it for chains.

gaps.title: Multi-location owner education
gaps.text: Boulevard has franchise guides, but rivals mostly write for single-site owners. Chain topics like multi-site reporting and rollout could be a deeper series.

gaps.title: Medspa comparison data
gaps.text: Mangomint has medspa and barbershop stats, but no rival offers chain-level benchmarks. Boulevard could publish original research from franchise customers.

versus.Zenoti: Zenoti publishes 21 new case stories to Boulevard's 4, and 6 comparison pages to Boulevard's 4, including one aimed at Boulevard.
versus.Mindbody: Mindbody had no new or updated pages, while Boulevard added 7 new pages and updated 8.
versus.Vagaro: Vagaro was inactive this period, while Boulevard published comparisons and case stories aimed at buyers.
versus.Mangomint: Mangomint writes mostly how-to and idea content for owners, while Boulevard focuses on buyers with comparisons, stories and landing pages.
versus.Phorest: Phorest publishes far more pages, many repeated, on clinics and payment costs, while Boulevard has fewer, more targeted pages on franchise scale.
versus.Fresha: Fresha has just 4 pages and no activity, so it is not competing with Boulevard on content.
